step3.title: 3. Environment Settings
step3.sshKeyHint: Enter your existing public key or generate a new one.
step3.downloadNote: If you generate a new key pair, the private key (.pem) will be downloaded automatically. Please keep it safe; it will not be shown again.

setup.wizardSubtitle: Configure the operating mode and default policies. Everything can be changed later in Admin → System Settings.

mode.containerDesc: Manage GPUs via K8s containers. Best for serving a GPU cluster to many users at scale.
mode.hybridDesc: Adds direct SSH access to physical nodes on top of containers. Best for small labs or when physical node leasing is needed.
mode.hybridNote: Selecting hybrid enables physical node leasing, SSH accounts, and per-node home quotas. (Implemented in a later phase)

billing.pricingHint: Choose how offering prices are set.
billing.pricingDynamic: Dynamic — price rises as availability drops
billing.surgeHint: Credits/hour increase by this amount each time resources get scarce.
billing.modeCreditDesc: Pay by deducting credits. Controlled by credits only, with no other limits.
billing.modeDynamicDesc: Use first-come without credits. Max lease, cooldown, and concurrent-session limits protect availability.
billing.modeFreeDesc: Use freely with no limits. No credits, leases, or concurrent-session caps.

idle.timeoutHint: Sessions are auto-reclaimed when the GPU stays idle for this long.
idle.containerNote: Container mode: reclaimed via Stop, preserving data.
idle.sshNote: SSH mode: data stays on local disk and can be reused as-is.

reclaim.stoppedTtlHint: Stopped sessions still hold their home disk. Past this age they become reclaim candidates. 0 = never reclaim automatically.
reclaim.note: Reclaim is based on idle time alone. A stopped session past the configured period has its home removed, regardless of node disk usage.
reclaim.exemptNote: Each user's most recent stopped session is never reclaimed. Running sessions are never touched.
reclaim.offNote: Automatic reclaim is off. Stopped sessions are held back only by the count limit and storage charges; admins must clean up manually when disks fill.

lease.extHoursHint: Max hours a user can pick per extension. (first-come mode only)
lease.maxExtHint: Max number of extensions per session. 0 disables extending.

review.hint: You will start with the settings below. Change them anytime in Admin → System Settings.

features.signupHint: When off, the signup link on the login page is hidden and accounts are created by admins.
features.datasetFeatureHint: When off, dataset menus, caching, and in-session dataset selection are all hidden (less dependence on central storage).
features.datasetHint: When off, users cannot register/request datasets; only admins register them.
features.alertsHint: When off, users cannot subscribe to GPU/node availability alerts.
features.groupJoinHint: When off, users cannot self-request membership; admins manage it.
features.creditHint: When off, users/groups cannot request top-ups; admins grant credits directly.

refill.title: Recurring refill
refill.note: Refills by this amount each cycle (0 disables it). The cycle cannot be longer than the parent's and is capped automatically.
refill.maxHint: Parent cycle limit: {{n}} days or fewer

credit_balance.teamBody: {{target}} team credits are at {{value}}, below the {{threshold}} threshold. Sessions in this team may stop soon.
